profile.summary: GSP Crop Science Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of agro chemicals in India and internationally. It offers insecticides, pesticides, and herbicides; and plant growth regulators and fungicides. The company serves farmers and institutional customers. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
